cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep my key or give it back. Let's settle what you meant by needing space last week.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wanted one quiet evening, not a breakup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep it, then. I'll come round tonight and we can put that evening behind us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keeping a key doesn't mean you can turn up at mine whenever you like.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll phone first. Keep it for visiting, or hand it back if that evening really was goodbye.
